title: Law to warn New Yorkers about Hajj travel scams
summary: This bill would direct the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, working with the Human Rights Commission, Office of Immigrant Affairs and Department for the Aging, to run an ongoing outreach program warning residents about scams related to Hajj travel, lodging, catering and visas. The agencies would produce and update materials in English and the city's designated languages, post them online, and step up efforts in the 180 days before each year's Hajj. It would take effect immediately after becoming law.
